mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) below their 12-month averages indicates a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO are below 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a CPIAUCSL reading above 212.5 indicates accelerating inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 212.5 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that boosts corporate profits and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index exceeds 215.0, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) indicate a robust economic environment that fuels corporate earnings and equity demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained economic regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 97.0) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 97.0 during supply-constrained regimes.
